title: We All Come from the Goddess
about: Chorus attributed to Z. Budapest; Hoof and Horn to Ian Corrigan. It is printed in Rainbow AU songs, vol. A, song #23, PDF p.10 (notated, five systems; Spanish verse). An independent version for comparison lives in Butterfly Bill’s RainbowChants · firecirclechants.com — the Goddess/Hoof-and-Horn medley is widely notated.
